'''Rose Uzoma Osuji''' (born 1947) is a Nigerian physicist. She is professor of physics at the [[University of Nigeria]], where she founded the [[nanotechnology]] research group. Her research interests include [[solar energy]] and [[materials science]].<ref name=AAS>{{cite web | title=Prof Rose Osuji | website=The African Academy of Sciences | url=https://aasciences.africa/fellows/rose-osuji | access-date=2015-10-19 }}</ref>

==Life==
Osuji served as head of the university's department of physics and astronomy from 2006 to 2008 and again from 2012 to 2015.<ref name=goroseway>{{cite web | title=About Prof. Osuji | website=Go Rose Way | url=https://www.goroseway.org/about-prof-osuji/ | access-date=2015-10-19 }}</ref>

In 2018 Osuji announced that the University of Nigeria would be partnering with the oil service company [[Oilserv]] to set up an African Centre for Nanosciences and Nanotechnology Research and Application.<ref>{{Cite news| author=Mbadiwe Okwo | title=Scientists gather at UNN for nanotechnology |newspaper=[[Vanguard (Nigeria)|Vanguard]]| date=July 17, 2018 | url=https://www.vanguardngr.com/2018/07/scientists-gather-at-unn-for-nanotechnology/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria| access-date=2015-10-19 }}</ref>

In 2022 Osuji was inducted as a [[Fellow of the African Academy of Sciences]].<ref name=AAS/><ref name=authorityngr>{{Cite news | author1=Assumpta Chinwe Nwanya | author2=Iheke Michael Nwachukwu | title=Celebrating the Legacy of Prof. Rose Uzoma Osuji: A Trailblazer in Science, Leadership, and Education |newspaper=[[The Authority (newspaper)|The Authority]]| date=December 9, 2024 | url=https://authorityngr.com/2024/12/09/celebrating-the-legacy-of-prof-rose-uzoma-osuji-a-trailblazer-in-science-leadership-and-education/ |location=Abuja, Nigeria| access-date=2015-10-19 }}</ref>
